description: ApplicationErrorEvent push ingest API + IncidentResponsePolicy per-tenant auto-response configuration + response action worker
scope_constraints: ApplicationErrorEvent push API authenticates via machine principal (X-Tenant-Id, X-Principal-Id, X-Scopes headers)
IncidentResponsePolicy is per-tenant; one policy per tenant_id
manual_override_only=true suppresses all automated actions regardless of severity
Worker dispatches open_ticket actions via TicketBridgeAdapter (injectable, currently FixtureNeutralTicketAdapter)
No direct modification of alerting, itsm, or notification schemas from g11 domain logic
All DB access through incident_response schema SECURITY DEFINER functions
